title: Maximizing Minimum Distance
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016
statement: You have to place (N+1) points in an N-dimensional space so that: 1. All these (N+1) points are 1 unit distance away from the origin (0, 0, \dots, 0). 2. The minimum distance between all pairs of these (N+1) points is maximized. If there are many solutions, output any of them.
